lines.en: I knock on Futaba’s door and wait for her to answer.
: Come in!
I worry for a moment that I may have accidentally selected Rin instead, but ultimately accept that she also lives in this room and that things like this will happen sometimes.
I make my way into the room and go to take my shoes off, but am quickly stopped by a brigade of [teenager]s who appear to be on some sort of mission.
: Yo! You’re just in time for our mission.
: Funny you should say that because-
: Because Sensei and I had other plans tonight.
: Thank you for showing up exactly when we agreed.
: Now, I suppose I’ll be-
: No way, Nodoka! We’re all in this together!
: But I am le tired...
: Uhh...I’m not interrupting something, am I?
: Not...particularly. But you did choose a bad time to show up.
: We’re about to go get ripped! Wanna come with us, Sensei?
: What?
: What...Rin is trying to say is that...a new gym just opened up in the area and...I’m trying to be a little...healthier.
: We are trying to be a little healthier.
: That's great, but isn’t it a little late to be going to the gym?
: There are actually a lot of people who prefer going later because...it means there will be less people around to...watch you.
: Like perverts?
: If we were worried about perverts, we wouldn’t have invited you!
: Or Nodoka, for that matter!
: Are you insinuating that I will be gazing longingly at your overworked, sweaty bodies, wishing to be the towel you use to dry yourselves off?
: Nodoka, if there is anyone who understands that exact train of thought, it is me.
: You are very much a beautiful disaster, Rin.
: Thank you! But today isn’t about our unearthly cravings for the touch of a cute girl! It is about willpower! And determination!
: Every day is about my unearthly craving for the touch of a cute girl.
: I’m with Nodoka on this.
: Of course you are...
: So...since that’s what we’re doing tonight...maybe you and Rin could...hang out some other time.
: Just to clarify, I came here to hang out with you, Futaba.
: What the hell?! But I’m the one who answered the door! That means you're here for me!
: E-Even if you’re here to see me...it doesn’t change that the three of us already have plans, so...
: Maybe some other time?
: I see no harm in Sensei coming along to scope out the area. Perhaps he, too, is looking to tone up a bit?
: I’m actually in surprisingly good shape for someone who never does anything.
: Well, at least on the outside.
: I’ve tried running with Miku before and it made me want to die, so...yeah. Not really into the idea of exercising with you guys.
: I...suppose if it’s just to...see the area, it’s fine...
: But...I already feel weird about doing this with Nodoka and Rin and...I’m sure you can see where I’m going with this.
: Yes, you are insecure about your body despite constant reminders from all of your friends and me that you’re gorgeous.
: Sensei...validation and...compliments are nice and everything, but...they can’t really change the way a person sees themself.
: So, yes...I am insecure and I’m...trying to actually go about handling that in a way that is...productive this time.
: Had you been handling it...unproductively up until now?
: The clock is ticking, the hours are going by. The past increases, the future recedes. Possibilities decreasing, regrets mounting.
: What happened “up until now” means absolutely nothing. And standing idly around and discussing it just prevents us from making the strides we need to reach our destination.
: In summation, as Futaba’s makeshift attorney and the guardian of her heart, I implore you to wait until she is comfortable with discussing such matters and-
: It’s okay, Nodoka...I’ve been meaning to tell him soon anyway.
: But “soon” is not today and I will not allow your already dwindling self-consciousness to become one more barrier between us and various exercise machines.
: Also, I want to see the exposed skin and tight, form-fitting spandex of women much older and stronger than me.
: That does sound alluring so, I am once again siding with Nodoka on this.
: So...you’re definitely coming?...
: I won’t stay to watch you guys work out.
: I do have time to kill, though, and knowing where a place like this is would be a good thing in the event that my lungs begin to tire out or something.
: Be sure to thank your organs every morning to prevent things like that from happening.
: That’s not how organs work, Nodoka.
: Well...so long as you promise to not...stick around...
: I guess it wouldn’t do any harm to just...walk there with you.
: It’s not particularly far or anything. It’s only a few blocks away from the dorm, so...I’m sure a lot of other girls will wind up going there soon as well...
: Speaking of which, where's Otoha? I could have sworn she was part of your...brigade.
: She’s...busy writing tonight. So we’re just going to go without her.
: She’d make us all feel weak and insignificant anyway since she actually works out and we are solanum tuberosum.
: You are...what?
: Potatoes.
: Right...
Futaba ultimately accepts that she will not be able to prevent me from tagging along and, after sighing heavily to herself as she so commonly does, the four of us leave the dorm.
We begin walking in the direction of the maid cafe and I inadvertently become a bit more excited than I should be.
But I calm myself down when I realize that I will not be seeing girls in maid outfits and will instead be seeing them in spandex.
Actually, nope. Not calm at all. This is just as good.
I thank the god I don’t believe in that I am wearing thick jeans and that any protrusion that may emerge from them is not my fault and that I can not be held accountable for having eyes.
Futaba tries to get me to leave once we arrive, but I remain insistent on seeing the inside as well because no one has changed clothes yet and that’s kind of why I came in the first place.
I’m sure that’s part of why she wants me to leave anyway, but I have seen her with immensely less clothing before and don’t quite understand why it’s suddenly a big deal.
Once the girls get dressed and all of us step into the gym, however, we discover that we are not the only ones here.
: I like the gym now.
: Is it...normal for your first reaction to a girl to be “Please hit me?”
: Exceedingly normal. There is no other reaction I would accept right now.
I’m a bit surprised to find Yuki, of all people, kickboxing a punching bag in the same gym that my students are now going to be visiting.
But, I suppose she needs some outlet for all of her built up anger now that she’s not...killing people for a living or whatever it is biker gangs do to stay afloat.
Also, under these circumstances, I too would enjoy being hit.
This might be the first time in my life I have ever wanted to switch places with a punching bag.
So, yeah. I guess this is a thing now.
: Still feeling up to this, Futaba?
: Well...it’s not like I have much of a choice since...all of us already came here.
: I’d feel bad if we didn’t at least do something.
: I...can’t help but feel a little intimidated by that woman, though...
: She doesn’t look so tough to me.
: Are you kidding? Look at her legs. Those things could kill someone.
And I’m sure they have.
: This might be the first time in my life I have ever wanted to switch places with a punching bag.
: I really think we might be related, Nodoka. It’s actually starting to become a real concern of mine.
: So...umm...now that we’re here...
: Are you going to get rid of me?
: I’m just...seeing if you’re going to be true to your word or not.
: Yeah, I’ll head out in a second. I’m just going to give that woman a piece of my mind first for intimidating all of you impressionable, [young_girls].
: W-Wait! You don’t have to go that far, Sensei!
: Yeah...No disrespect to you, but I’m pretty sure that girl could take you.
: She can take me any day of the week.
: Don’t worry about it, Futaba. I know exactly how to deal with girls like her.
: Sensei!
I make my way over to Yuki, breaking her concentration on the punching bag and allowing it to live at least one more minute before being blown into pieces.
: Oh shit. What are you doing here?
: You didn’t really strike me as the type to work out.
: Yuki, can you help me look cool in front of my students and pretend that I intimidated you out of the gym?
: You fuckin’ serious right now?
: Yuki, please. They need to know how cool I am.
: Fuck no, man. I’m still on my free trial. I’ve gotta make use of this time.
: Unless you’re tryin’ to pay for my subscription or some shit.
: I can’t. I’m already paying for your daughter’s phone bill.
: Oh. Well then no fuckin’ wonder she’s okay with screwing someone your age.
: For the last time, I-
: Hi there. Nodoka Nagasawa. I may look fragile, but I am willing to take any punishment you’d like to throw at me.
: Are you at all interested in younger women?
: What?
: Excuse me, but...I can’t figure out how to turn on the water in the shower room...
: You just...
: You turn the knob...
: Can...
: Can you show me?...
: And stay out, bitch.
: Hah...
: You’re gonna owe me dinner for this shit.
: She’s gone. Your problems are solved.
: Uhh...Not all of them...
: You’re still here...
: Am I not allowed to support you the same way your other friends do?
: Sensei...you can...support me in your own way...
: But...it’s pretty obvious that the reason you’re sticking around isn’t because of that.
: Why is that obvious? I can do nice things from time to time.
: Because...
: Because...uhh...
: What? What are you looking-
: Oh.
I guess my pants weren’t thick enough after all.
: Hey!
: Hi, Rin. Don’t look down.
: Of course I’m going to look down if you tell me not-
: Oh.
: Well...yeah. Okay then.
: I tried to warn you.
: Yeah...Yeah, you did.
: Uhh...
: I’m gonna go...punch things or...something...
: Okay, have fun.
: Uhhhhhhhhh okay.
: So...you see now why I feel weird about you staying here?
: It makes a little more sense now, yes.
: But I still don’t think you should be embarrassed about working out in front of me.
: I think it’s great that you’re trying to be healthier and-
: Can you please...not do this right now?...
: You can come see me tomorrow and...we’ll spend time together then...
: But if I’m going to be serious about doing this...I kind of need you to...not be around for it...
: It’s obviously nothing personal...I just...
: I’m really...uncomfortable in my own skin, Sensei...
: And...no amount of encouragement or validation is going to change that...
: So...please...
: At least...not until I’m feeling a little better about this...
I sigh to myself and accept that I’ve probably overstepped my boundaries tonight.
I overstep my boundaries all the time, though.
I guess I just didn’t expect to be pushed back so firmly by Futaba of all people.
Now that the tears have started to show up, though, I’m obviously not going to stick around any longer.
Blowing things out of proportion wasn’t really at the top of my to-do list today, and it’s already starting to get late.
So...I should probably stop prodding her for now and wait until another opportunity arrives to see if we can progress any further.
: Okay, I’m leaving.
: I’m happy for you, though.
: Well, as happy as I can be. Happiness isn’t really my thing.
: And working out isn’t mine, but...we have to start somewhere.
: I’m sorry for almost crying.
: I’m sorry for making you almost cry.
: Well, as sorry as I can be. Apologeticness isn’t really my thing either.
: Okay...that’s enough. I’m not talking to you anymore.
: That’s fine. I’ll just go talk to Nodoka or-
: Wait, where did Nodoka go?
: Oh, she ran after that badass biker chick once she left.
: Yeah...
: Yeah, that checks out.
I leave the gym and begin my journey home.
I’m not sure how often I’ll go back to a place like that, especially considering that a certain someone really does not want me around, but I’m glad to know it exists, I guess.
It’s good that Futaba is trying to change the parts of herself that she doesn’t like.
If you don’t do that while you’re young, they’ll likely wind up becoming hideous aspects of yourself that are impossible to ignore or fix.
And, no matter how hard you try to shut them out, something will always happen to remind you of them.
To transport you back to better days, when it was still possible to-
I decide to call Ami and talk to her for the rest of my walk home.
Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
You have received a new picture message from Rin!
